lines.text: Lesson eighteen: volume, volatility and range.
lines.say: Lesson eighteen: volume, volatility and range.

lines.text: Three ways to describe how busy and how jumpy a market is.
lines.say: Three ways to describe how busy and how jumpy a market is.

lines.text: In lesson seventeen, you met zones, breakouts and fakeouts.
lines.say: In lesson seventeen, you met zones, breakouts and fakeouts.

lines.text: Here are two fictional charts. Both start at 60,000 and end at 60,100.
lines.say: Here are two fictional charts. Both start at sixty thousand and end at sixty thousand one hundred.

lines.text: Same change in price. A very different ride. Let's measure it.
lines.say: Same change in price. A very different ride. Let's measure it.

lines.text: Volume is how much was traded in a period of time.
lines.say: Volume is how much was traded in a period of time.

lines.text: Think of a shop counting how many items it sold each minute.
lines.say: Think of a shop counting how many items it sold each minute.

lines.text: In this fictional minute, trades of 2, 5, 3 and 2 BTC go through.
lines.say: In this fictional minute, trades of two, five, three and two B-T-C go through.

lines.text: Add them up: 12 BTC. That is this candle's volume.
lines.say: Add them up: twelve B-T-C. That is this candle's volume.

lines.text: At 60,000 USDT each, that's about 720,000 USDT traded.
lines.say: At sixty thousand U-S-D-T each, that's about seven hundred twenty thousand U-S-D-T traded.

lines.text: On most charts, volume shows as bars under the candles.
lines.say: On most charts, volume shows as bars under the candles.

lines.text: Each bar sits under its own candle, and covers the same minute.
lines.say: Each bar sits under its own candle, and covers the same minute.

lines.text: A short bar means a quiet minute. A tall bar means a busy one.
lines.say: A short bar means a quiet minute. A tall bar means a busy one.

lines.text: Here, the busiest minutes came with big moves. Often, not always.
lines.say: Here, the busiest minutes came with big moves. Often, not always.

lines.text: Range is the distance between the high and the low.
lines.say: Range is the distance between the high and the low.

lines.text: Like the gap between the warmest and coldest hour of a day.
lines.say: Like the gap between the warmest and coldest hour of a day.

lines.text: This candle's high is 60,300 and its low is 60,000. Range: 300 USDT.
lines.say: This candle's high is sixty thousand three hundred and its low is sixty thousand. Range: three hundred U-S-D-T.

lines.text: As a percent: 300 ÷ 60,000 × 100 = 0.5%. We divide by the low.
lines.say: As a percent: three hundred divided by sixty thousand times one hundred equals zero point five percent. We divide by the low.

lines.text: Volatility is how much, and how fast, price moves around.
lines.say: Volatility is how much, and how fast, price moves around.

lines.text: Like a calm lake versus a choppy sea.
lines.say: Like a calm lake versus a choppy sea.

lines.text: On the left, four quiet candles. Their ranges average 40 USDT.
lines.say: On the left, four quiet candles. Their ranges average forty U-S-D-T.

lines.text: On the right, four volatile candles. Ranges average 250 USDT.
lines.say: On the right, four volatile candles. Ranges average two hundred fifty U-S-D-T.

lines.text: More volatility means bigger swings, both ways.
lines.say: More volatility means bigger swings, both ways.

lines.text: Traders often check the previous high and low of the last few minutes.
lines.say: Traders often check the previous high and low of the last few minutes.

lines.text: This box is a lookback window: the last 10 one-minute candles.
lines.say: This box is a lookback window: the last ten one-minute candles.

lines.text: Highest high 60,300. Lowest low 60,000. Range 300 USDT, or 0.5%.
lines.say: Highest high sixty thousand three hundred. Lowest low sixty thousand. Range three hundred U-S-D-T, or zero point five percent.

lines.text: Now stretch it to 15 minutes. An older high, 60,600, joins in.
lines.say: Now stretch it to fifteen minutes. An older high, sixty thousand six hundred, joins in.

lines.text: Range doubles: 600 USDT, 1%. Your window changes the answer.
lines.say: Range doubles: six hundred U-S-D-T, one percent. Your window changes the answer.

lines.text: Let's compare two fictional 15-minute windows.
lines.say: Let's compare two fictional fifteen-minute windows.

lines.text: Window A: range 150 USDT, 0.25%, and low volume.
lines.say: Window A: range one hundred fifty U-S-D-T, zero point two five percent, and low volume.

lines.text: Window B: range 900 USDT, 1.5%, and high volume.
lines.say: Window B: range nine hundred U-S-D-T, one point five percent, and high volume.

lines.text: In A, round-trip fees of 0.10%, 60 USDT per BTC, eat a big part of the range.
lines.say: In A, round-trip fees of zero point one percent, sixty U-S-D-T per B-T-C, eat a big part of the range.

lines.text: In B, moves are bigger, but so are the swings against you.
lines.say: In B, moves are bigger, but so are the swings against you.

lines.text: Volume also hints at liquidity: how many orders wait near the price.
lines.say: Volume also hints at liquidity: how many orders wait near the price.

lines.text: Busy book: a 2 BTC market buy fills at 60,000.
lines.say: Busy book: a two B-T-C market buy fills at sixty thousand.

lines.text: Thin book: 1 BTC fills at 60,000, the other at 60,100.
lines.say: Thin book: one B-T-C fills at sixty thousand, the other at sixty thousand one hundred.

lines.text: Average 60,050. That's 50 USDT per BTC worse: slippage.
lines.say: Average sixty thousand fifty. That's fifty U-S-D-T per B-T-C worse: slippage.

lines.text: Quiet times often mean thin books.
lines.say: Quiet times often mean thin books.

lines.text: A common mistake: a huge volume bar means strong buyers. Go long!
lines.say: A common mistake: a huge volume bar means strong buyers. Go long!

lines.text: But every trade has a buyer and a seller. 40 BTC bought means 40 BTC sold.
lines.say: But every trade has a buyer and a seller. Forty B-T-C bought means forty B-T-C sold.

lines.text: Volume shows how busy it was, not who wins next.
lines.say: Volume shows how busy it was, not who wins next.

lines.text: Read it with candles and zones. WAIT is still allowed.
lines.say: Read it with candles and zones. Wait is still allowed.

lines.text: Your turn. In the last 10 minutes, the high was 60,240 and the low 60,000.
lines.say: Your turn. In the last ten minutes, the high was sixty thousand two hundred forty and the low sixty thousand.

lines.text: What is the range in USDT, and as a percent? Pause if you need to.
lines.say: What is the range in U-S-D-T, and as a percent? Pause if you need to.
Range: sixty thousand two hundred forty minus sixty thousand equals two hundred forty U-S-D-T. Then two hundred forty divided by sixty thousand times one hundred equals zero point four percent.

lines.text: That tells you how far price travelled. Not where it goes next.
lines.say: That tells you how far price travelled. Not where it goes next.

lines.text: Before you lean on these numbers, know the limits.
lines.say: Before you lean on these numbers, know the limits.

lines.text: A past range is history. The next minutes can be calmer, or much wilder.
lines.say: A past range is history. The next minutes can be calmer, or much wilder.

lines.text: Volatility can jump fast. With leverage, big swings reach liquidation sooner.
lines.say: Volatility can jump fast. With leverage, big swings reach liquidation sooner.

lines.text: Thin volume can mean slippage. And WAIT is always a valid choice.
lines.say: Thin volume can mean slippage. And wait is always a valid choice.

lines.text: Let's recap.
lines.say: Let's recap.

lines.text: Volume is how much traded. It shows activity, not direction.
lines.say: Volume is how much traded. It shows activity, not direction.

lines.text: Range is high minus low. Volatility is how big and fast the swings are.
lines.say: Range is high minus low. Volatility is how big and fast the swings are.

lines.text: The lookback window you choose changes the range. Past ranges promise nothing.
lines.say: The lookback window you choose changes the range. Past ranges promise nothing.

lines.text: Check yourself: a huge green volume bar. Does it prove price will rise?
lines.say: Check yourself: a huge green volume bar. Does it prove price will rise?

lines.text: No. Volume shows activity, not direction. Every buy had a seller.
lines.say: No. Volume shows activity, not direction. Every buy had a seller.

lines.text: Well done! Phase 5 starts next: what is scalping? See you in lesson nineteen.
lines.say: Well done! Phase five starts next: what is scalping? See you in lesson nineteen.
